name: codemagic-patch
title: Codemagic Patch
description: Over-the-air updates for React Native and Capacitor apps, signing in with GitHub, Bitbucket Cloud or GitLab, on R2 or Google Cloud buckets.
notes: Before you install: Codemagic publishes no server image, so build one from the release tag into a private registry (Caravana's deploy/examples/codemagic-patch/RUNBOOK.md has a workflow for it) and add the registry's login in Settings, Registries. Make two buckets, one public and one private, and a key with read and write on both. On Google Cloud: the downloads URL is https://storage.googleapis.com/<public bucket>, give allUsers the role Storage Legacy Object Reader on it (read by name, no listing), and use a service account's HMAC key. On R2: give the public bucket a custom domain and use it as the downloads URL. Choose how people sign in and make an OAuth app at that provider. GitHub: an OAuth App whose homepage is https://{{domain}}. Bitbucket: Workspace settings, OAuth consumers, Add consumer, callback URL https://{{domain}}/auth/callback, This is a private consumer checked, permissions Account: Read and Email. GitLab: an application with the redirect URI https://{{domain}}/auth/callback and the scopes the dashboard asks for. Then sign in at https://{{domain}} with the admin email, which must be your confirmed primary email at the provider. Both addresses are written into your apps' builds, so choose them once. Postgres is backed up every day at 03:00 UTC, keeping 14.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Server image
inputs.help: The image you built, with its version tag (not latest).

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Server domain
inputs.help: The API and dashboard. DNS must point at this server. The sign-in callback is https://<domain>/auth/callback.

inputs.name: signin
inputs.label: Sign-in with
inputs.help: How people sign in to the dashboard. Each provider asks for its own OAuth app below.

inputs.name: gh_client_id
inputs.label: GitHub OAuth client ID
inputs.help: From the GitHub OAuth app the dashboard signs in with.

inputs.name: gh_client_secret
inputs.label: GitHub OAuth client secret
inputs.help: From the same GitHub OAuth app.

inputs.name: bb_client_id
inputs.label: Bitbucket consumer key
inputs.help: The Key of the Bitbucket OAuth consumer. Its callback URL is https://<domain>/auth/callback.

inputs.name: bb_client_secret
inputs.label: Bitbucket consumer secret
inputs.help: The Secret of the same OAuth consumer.

inputs.name: gl_client_id
inputs.label: GitLab application ID
inputs.help: From the GitLab application. Its redirect URI is https://<domain>/auth/callback.

inputs.name: gl_client_secret
inputs.label: GitLab application secret
inputs.help: The Secret of the same GitLab application.

inputs.name: gl_base_url
inputs.label: GitLab address
inputs.help: Only for a GitLab you host yourself. Empty means https://gitlab.com.

inputs.name: admin_email
inputs.label: Admin email
inputs.help: The first admin of the dashboard.

inputs.name: public_url
inputs.label: Downloads URL
inputs.help: Where apps download updates: the public bucket's address. https://storage.googleapis.com/<bucket> on Google Cloud, or the R2 bucket's custom domain.

inputs.name: bucket
inputs.label: Public bucket
inputs.help: The public bucket: anyone may read its files.

inputs.name: internal_bucket
inputs.label: Private bucket
inputs.help: The bucket for the server's own files. It must never be public.

inputs.name: s3_endpoint
inputs.label: S3 endpoint
inputs.help: The buckets' S3 API: https://storage.googleapis.com on Google Cloud, https://<account ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com on R2.

inputs.name: s3_region
inputs.label: S3 region
inputs.help: auto on R2; the buckets' location on Google Cloud, such as us-central1.

inputs.name: s3_access_key_id
inputs.label: S3 access key ID
inputs.help: With read and write on both buckets: an R2 API token, or a Google Cloud HMAC key of a service account.

inputs.name: s3_secret_access_key
inputs.label: S3 secret access key
inputs.help: From the same token or HMAC key.
